$comment: Per-project overlay for ui-polish-loop. Copy to <repo>/docs/design-system/ui-polish-loop-overlay.json (or fold into an existing playbook) and fill. RULE: the loop/dimensions/triage/terminal-states are project-agnostic; everything project-specific lives HERE. Do NOT fabricate any of these values: if the human hasn't stated them, ask (propose-first).
tier$comment: T0 = loop only (no gate). T1 = has a mechanical gate. T2 = also has a screen/node-id registry. T3 = also has a recorded decision library. State this honestly; T0 is a valid, common answer.

gate.$comment: T1+. Never re-implement a project's gate in the skill — call it. If none exists, leave hasGate:false and the loop runs on judgement (design-tweaker) instead of mechanical auto-fix.
gate.location: <path to the project's gate/build-kit functions, if any>

registry.$comment: T2. screen <-> node-id <-> flow map. Without it, cross-screen checks (§3c) are manual.
registry.location: <path to the project's screen/flow registry, if any>

decisionLibrary.$comment: T3. Ledger of intentional exceptions ('don't fix these') that a mechanical gate would otherwise flag as defects.

components.$comment: So the generic cross-screen checks (§3c) know what to look for in THIS design system.
components.footerComponent: <name of the footer/actions-row component, if any>

experiences$comment: Only if this design system serves more than one sibling brand/product (e.g. an internal tool + a customer-facing app) sharing the same file. Each entry: { name, brand, chromeNotes }. Leave empty for a single-experience project.

copy.$comment: Pointer to the project's UX-writing canon. Guessing register/acronyms produces noise on every acronym in the product.
copy.lexiconLocation: <path to the project's copy/UX-writing canon, if any>

scopeGuard: <one-line statement of what this loop must NOT invent, typically: DS-only, no new component/variant without a separate proposal>
